description.value:
It may look like a toy, but it sure doesn't shoot like one.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 15 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: After being charged, this weapon’s Tech Rebuild remains so until the end of a Turn in which it was fired. While charged, this weapon functions as ROF 1, expends 5 rounds in a burst with every Attack, deals 2d6 additional damage (5d6), and whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 2 additional SP. If there are less than 5 rounds in the magazine, firing this weapon while its Tech Rebuild is charged empties the magazine. Incompatible with Pistol Auto Sear.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
